entries.german: Johannes de Rosenberch beurkundet, nos ius piscandi habuisse in flumine dicto Muhla, quantum fluit in nostri provintialis iudicii potestate, videlicet de villa Sweikkersraut dicta versus monasterium in Plaga sancte Marie in fundis eiusdem cenobii per ascensum, und verzichtet (resignamus) darauf zu Gunsten des Stiftes.Siegler: der Aussteller.In octava beati Johannis baptiste.
entries.english: Hans von Rosenberg certifies that he held the right to fish in the river called Muhla, as far as it flows within the jurisdiction of his provincial court, from Sweikkersraut toward the monastery at Plaga sancte Marie through the monastery’s lands, and relinquishes that right in favor of the monastery. The issuer’s seal is attached.
